feed.title: Underkeel notes
feed.subtitle: Measurements of exit cost and liquidations in Morpho Blue markets on Base

entry.title: A $1M USDe sale on Base costs 37.7% against a 2.55% break-even
entry.summary: USDe/USDC 91.5% is the second largest Morpho market on Base, with $329M borrowed. On 17 November a $200k sale of USDe cost 0.10%, and a $1M sale cost 37.7%.
entry.content: Selling $200k of USDe into USDC on Base cost 0.10% at 06:23 UTC on 17 November. Selling $1M cost 37.7%. A liquidation in the USDe/USDC 91.5% market on Morpho pays only while the sale costs less than 2.55%.

entry.title: Two minutes when a 12.7% bonus was not enough
entry.summary: On 8 November cbXRP traded 8-9% below Coinbase on Base. In the cbXRP/USDC 62.5% market on Morpho, 140 liquidations waited between 4.6 and 80 seconds for a taker.
entry.content: On 8 November, in the minute after 21:56 UTC, cbXRP on Base exchanges traded 9.1% below XRP on Coinbase, and in the next minute 8.0% below. During those two minutes 140 positions in the cbXRP/USDC 62.5% market on Morpho stayed liquidatable for anything between 4.6 and 80 seconds before somebody took them.
